# Route4me

Route4Me provides a Last Mile Routing API offering automated solutions for route planning and optimization, tailored for logistics-intensive businesses.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/route4me/.

## Actions

- **Get Vehicles** (read-only): Retrieve details of vehicles in the organization.
- **Set Destination Status**: Set or update the status of one or more route destinations.
